name: Be-reave Secondary
source:
-There are four mini games in this part. In Blueeyes/graymaN, a guy got his wish of seeing a girl he met long ago, but might have some trouble keeping her. In Sora, a terminally ill guy might get saved by someone who love him. In Instant Spir, a guy can help out some special people. In Gyu, with two magical girl's help, a girl can't go wrong, or can she? Again, there are extra endings if you played all four mini games, but you might need to get the bug fix file to see them.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
本部分包含四个迷你游戏。在《Blueeyes/graymaN》中，一名男子如愿见到了多年前邂逅的少女，却可能难以让她留在身边；在《Sora》中，一名身患绝症的男子或许会被爱他的人拯救；在《Instant Spir》中，一名男子可以帮助某些特别的人；在《Gyu》中，有两名魔法少女相助，一名少女应该不会出错——真的如此吗？再次提醒，游玩全部四个迷你游戏后还会出现额外结局，但可能需要安装错误修复文件才能看到。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
